- **End:** the letter after it also differs (t, o, k, m), so it can't run any further.

**Repeats that came close:**

- **Other repeats of 40+ letters:** the tool found only two more, and each occurs just twice. They are longer versions of the same refrain.

The tool only reports repeats it records as separate phrases, so a repeat it didn't record could in principle be missed. That's very unlikely for one of 40+ letters occurring 8 or more times.
